# Upstream Gameplan

Clone or submodule the upstream repo here for local Frappe bench development:

```bash
git submodule add https://github.com/frappe/gameplan vendor/gameplan
```

Docker init (`docker/init-gameplan.sh`) uses `bench get-app gameplan` from GitHub when this directory is empty.

AGPL-3.0 — see upstream `LICENSE`. Customer branding is applied via `frappe-app/indobase_discuss`.
